discrepancies.title: Version and Chunk Count Conflation (v0.2.0 vs v0.3.0)
discrepancies.reported_claim: v0.2.0 contains 3,582 chunks from 50 canonical papers.
discrepancies.actual_fact: dataset/processed/v0.2.0/chunks.parquet contains 719 chunks from 8 pilot documents. dataset/processed/v0.3.0/chunks.parquet contains 3,582 chunks from 50 documents. v0.1.0 canonical_papers.parquet contains 528 metadata papers, while 50 papers have processed full text.
discrepancies.impact: Code referencing v0.2.0 was querying the 8-paper pilot corpus (719 chunks) rather than the full 50-paper expansion corpus (3,582 chunks).

discrepancies.title: Trusted Edge Conflation (Document Containment vs Scientific Relationships)
discrepancies.reported_claim: Graph contains 618 nodes, 31 total edges, and 22 trusted edges, while 9 Cartesian edges are isolated as unsupported.
discrepancies.actual_fact: All 22 'trusted edges' are Paper -> CONTAINS -> Statement structural containment edges. The only 9 concept-to-concept relationship edges in v0.5.1 are the 9 Cartesian-product table relationships from chunk chk_rg_doi_ebe643c2b3dd_A_0135, all marked UNSUPPORTED. There are exactly 0 trusted semantic relationships in the graph.
discrepancies.impact: The research graph contains zero trusted scientific concept relationships; traversal relies entirely on lexical/hybrid retrieval rather than trusted graph edges.

discrepancies.title: Ingestion of Unsupported Cartesian Relationships into Dead-End Graveyard
discrepancies.reported_claim: The 9 Cartesian-product relationships are marked unsupported and strictly excluded from trusted discovery by default.
discrepancies.actual_fact: DeadEndGraveyard.build_index() queries 'SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE relation_type IN ("LIMITED_BY", "CONTRADICTS")' without filtering by evidence_support == 'SUPPORTED'. Consequently, 3 of the 7 negative knowledge records (neg_rel_kb_rel_9eacb770b891, neg_rel_kb_rel_bf57d03902f7, neg_rel_kb_rel_c043dbedbb58) are derived directly from the unverified Cartesian artifact chunk chk_rg_doi_ebe643c2b3dd_A_0135.
discrepancies.impact: Unsupported negative relationships were inadvertently ingested into the dead-end risk assessment index.

discrepancies.title: Synthetic / Rule-Based Relevance Ground Truth Described as Benchmark
discrepancies.reported_claim: Empirical retrieval evaluation benchmark measuring Precision@k, Recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k across BM25, Dense Vector, and Hybrid RRF.
discrepancies.actual_fact: Relevance ground truth is computed by a rule-based term-matching heuristic (is_relevant: target concept in text OR >=2 keyword overlap). No human relevance judgments were collected. This introduces structural bias favoring lexical matching.
discrepancies.impact: Retrieval metrics reflect lexical keyword overlap rather than human-evaluated scientific semantic relevance.

discrepancies.title: Ablation Delta is an Arithmetic Artifact of Discrete Weighting
discrepancies.reported_claim: Ablation study proved that cross-domain distance provides a +0.0800 ranking advantage for non-obvious transfer.
discrepancies.actual_fact: In scorer.py, when cross-domain distance is enabled and domains differ, s_dist is assigned 0.90. When disabled, s_dist is assigned 0.50. With weight_distance = 0.20, the delta is identically (0.90 - 0.50) * 0.20 = 0.0800. This is an algebraic property of the formula, not an empirical discovery metric.
discrepancies.impact: Ablation reflects mathematical formula mechanics rather than measured scientific discovery quality.

discrepancies.title: False-Novelty Prevention is an Architectural Invariant, External Search is Stubbed
discrepancies.reported_claim: 100% false-novelty prevention rate demonstrated across benchmark test cases.
discrepancies.actual_fact: The GapStatus enum does not contain a VERIFIED_NOVEL member (only POSSIBLE_GAP, EVIDENCE_AGAINST_GAP, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, REQUIRES_REVIEW). The verifier cannot output novel by design. External search adapters do not execute live HTTP requests to OpenAlex/arXiv; they return recommended query strings.
discrepancies.impact: The prevention rate is an invariant guarantee, not a statistical benchmark finding. External search is recommended, not live.

discrepancies.title: Reviewer #2 is Purely Rule-Based; Experiment Designer Plans are Pre-Registrations
discrepancies.reported_claim: Hypotheses critically evaluated by Adversarial Reviewer; executable experiment plans designed.
discrepancies.actual_fact: AdversarialReviewer is a deterministic heuristic evaluating evidence excerpt counts, baseline keywords, and non-iid parameter strings. Zero LLM calls are made. Experiment plans are pre-registration specifications with execution_status='PLANNED_READY_FOR_EXECUTION', not executed laboratory experiments.
discrepancies.impact: Scientific validity of generated hypotheses is unverified by human peer reviewers.
